prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic cute urban lifestyle portrait of an approved adult woman.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with a round face, natural skin texture, light makeup, subtle blush, round brown eyeglasses, and long natural dark-brown waves, wearing a grey cable-knit sweater over a white collared shirt, opaque brown knee-length skirt, knee-high grey socks, and brown casual lace-up shoes.
prompt.composition_elements: High-angle street portrait, subject leaning slightly forward while holding a takeaway coffee cup with both hands, modern glass building, metal railings, green-and-white roadside barrier, clean sidewalk.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural daylight with soft shadows, fresh candid city mood, realistic proportions and true-to-life colors.
prompt.technical_specs: High-resolution smartphone wide-angle street photography, sharp focus, natural skin, hair, knit and coffee texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic high-angle street portrait of an approved adult woman with a round face, natural skin texture, light makeup, subtle blush, round brown eyeglasses, and long dark-brown natural waves. She wears a grey cable-knit sweater over a white collared shirt, an opaque brown knee-length skirt, knee-high grey socks, and brown casual lace-up shoes. She leans slightly forward while holding a takeaway coffee cup with both hands. The urban sidewalk includes a modern glass-windowed building, metal railings, a green-and-white roadside barrier, and clean city details. Use bright natural daylight, soft shadows, a smartphone wide-angle perspective, sharp realistic texture, and a cute cozy urban lifestyle mood.
